abstract: Mid- and low-level managers play a significant role within the organizational hierarchy, far beyond monitoring. It is often their responsibility to respond to opportunities and threats within their units by adjusting their subordinates’ assignments. Most such managers, however, lack the authority to adapt their subordinates’ wages. Instead, they rely on other, more restrictive incentive schemes. We study the interaction between a front-line manager and worker and characterize the “managerial style” as a function of the players’ relative patience and information. This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy. Funding: D. Bird acknowledges financial support from the Sapir Center for Economic Development. A. Frug acknowledges financial support from the Agencia Estatal de Investigación (Spain) [Grants RYC2021-033938-I and PID2021-125538NB-I00].
abstract_zh: 中低层管理者在组织层级中发挥着重要作用，远不止于监督。他们通常负责通过调整下属的任务分配来应对其所在单位内部的机遇与威胁。然而，大多数此类管理者缺乏调整下属工资的权力。因此，他们转而依赖其他更为受限的激励方案。我们研究一线管理者与员工之间的互动，并将“管理风格”刻画为参与者相对耐心与信息的函数。本文由Maria Guadalupe（商业战略方向）接受。资助：D. Bird感谢Sapir经济发展中心的资助。A. Frug感谢西班牙国家研究署的资助[项目编号RYC2021-033938-I和PID2021-125538NB-I00]。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: A Theory of Front-Line Management

abstract: We examine the link between short-term pressures and technologically significant innovation in U.S. public firms in 1997–2015. Using a market-based measure of short-term pressure, we estimate its relationship with influential and novel patents. We find that firms facing more intense short-term pressures are less likely to patent highly influential or novel innovations. To evaluate whether this relationship is causal, we use changes in ownership styles following financial institution mergers as instruments. Our analysis suggests that changing short-term pressures from investors had a causal impact on firm innovative outcomes; this finding is robust to a wide variety of empirical specifications. While public firms as a whole retained a constant share of highly influential patents, this activity has become more concentrated in fewer firms. This shift does not appear to be fully compensated by an increase in technologically significant patents by nonpublic firms such as venture-capital (VC)-backed start-ups. These findings raise questions about capital markets’ impact on firm R&D strategy and the nature of innovative activities in public firms. This paper was accepted by Ashish Arora, entrepreneurship and innovation. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge financial support from the inaugural Panmure House Prize for Long-term Thinking and Radical Innovation for this research, as well as Matt Marx for facilitating institutional support at Cornell for this research. B. Goldfarb and R. Corredoira received partial financial support from the National Science Foundation [Grant 1565553]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00857 .
abstract_zh: 我们考察了1997—2015年美国上市公司短期压力与技术性重大创新之间的联系。使用基于市场的短期压力衡量指标，我们估计了其与有影响力和新颖专利之间的关系。我们发现，面临更强烈短期压力的公司更不可能申请具有高度影响力或新颖性的创新专利。为评估这一关系是否具有因果性，我们使用金融机构合并后所有权风格的变化作为工具变量。我们的分析表明，来自投资者的短期压力变化对企业创新产出具有因果影响；这一发现对多种实证设定均稳健。尽管上市公司整体上保持了高度影响力专利的恒定份额，但此类活动已变得更加集中于少数公司。这种转变似乎并未由非上市公司——如风险投资（VC）支持的初创企业——在技术性重大专利上的增加所完全补偿。这些发现对资本市场对企业研发战略的影响以及上市公司创新活动的性质提出了疑问。本文由Ashish Arora（创业与创新领域）接受。资助：作者衷心感谢首届Panmure House长期思维与激进创新奖为本研究提供的财务支持，以及Matt Marx为本研究在康奈尔大学促成机构支持。B. Goldfarb和R. Corredoira获得了美国国家科学基金会[Grant 1565553]的部分财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00857获取。

title: The Changing Nature of Firm Innovation: Short-Termism and Influential Innovation in U.S. Public Firms
title_zh: 企业创新的演变本质：美国上市公司的短期主义与影响力创新

abstract: We adopt a data-driven approach to measure trade decoupling over 2015-2023. Countries are classified into three groups according to changes in their data-inferred trade costs with the US and China: those shifting toward the US bloc, those shifting toward the China bloc, and those with no change in alignment. We document that while cross-bloc trade costs rose, they were accompanied by falling within-bloc trade costs, with average trade costs falling marginally in line with global trade resilience. We use a quantitative model to compute the real income effects of this reconfiguration of trade costs. Model simulations suggest that real income in the median country in the world, and the median country within each bloc, rose by 0.4-0.6%. Finally, we find a modest amount of bloc misalignment: the median country would be better off switching blocs. These results suggest that trade decoupling may not follow trade-driven economic interests.
abstract_zh: 我们采用数据驱动的方法来衡量2015年至2023年间的贸易脱钩现象。根据各国与美国和中国之间数据推断贸易成本的变化，将国家分为三组：转向美国阵营的、转向中国阵营的，以及联盟关系未发生变化的。我们记录到，虽然跨阵营贸易成本上升，但伴随而来的是阵营内贸易成本下降，平均贸易成本略有下降，这与全球贸易韧性相符。我们运用定量模型来计算这种贸易成本重构对实际收入的影响。模型模拟结果显示，世界中等国家以及各阵营内中等国家的实际收入增长了0.4%至0.6%。最后，我们发现存在适度的阵营错位：中等国家若转换阵营将获益更多。这些结果表明，贸易脱钩可能并不符合贸易驱动的经济利益。
